title: UTR Rating Weekly Trend
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utr:rating
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(rating_value) as total_value avg(rating_value) as avg_value count as sessions by _time
| sort - _time
description: Trends UTR rating week by week so you can see whether utr rating is building, fading, or plateauing.
value: A weekly view turns isolated workouts or events into a training signal, making it easier to spot whether utr rating is moving in the right direction.
implementation: Forward utr rating into `index=personal`, keep `rating_value` populated, and review the weekly trend before planning the next block.
visualization: Line chart of weekly total and average UTR rating.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how utr rating changes from week to week so you can tell whether training or racing is moving the right way.
